text_to_image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE original fictional adult male character, age 23–27, strikingly handsome with refined youthful romantic-lead appeal, natural charismatic gaze and excellent facial harmony. This must be a new invented person, not a celebrity likeness. Use the individual facial design described below while retaining beauty and subtle natural asymmetry. Clean groomed skin with fine natural pores, no artificial smoothing or exaggerated blemishes, clean-shaven unless specified. A polished yet believable everyday editorial photo, not a passport picture. Vertical 3:4 image, eye-level, head facing forward, direct eye contact, complete hair, both shoulders and half body framed to just above waist, relaxed elegant posture, face prominent. Entire background is flat opaque pure white #FFFFFF, bright soft frontal studio light, low shadow, natural skin texture, slight halation, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field with both eyes sharp. No props, text, logos, watermark, other people, collage, cutout, transparency or vignette. East Asian man with tousled honey-ash blond layers, expressive and approachable, cream lightweight jacket over dark shirt. NEW facial design: heart-shaped face, round cheeks and a firm small chin, thin rising eyebrows, narrow long eyes with monolids, softly convex nose bridge, wide cupid-bow lips. Warm fair skin.
